# Sendlyr

> Sendlyr helps product teams discover and validate product activation indicators.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://sendlyr.com/): Activation Signal Sprint overview and Typesy VIP result.
- [How it works](https://sendlyr.com/how-it-works): Discover, validate, and operate method.
- [Typesy VIP case study](https://sendlyr.com/blog/pai-discovery-case-study): Controlled leading-indicator experiment.
- [Fitness apps](https://sendlyr.com/for/fitness-apps): Fitness activation use case.
- [Cooking apps](https://sendlyr.com/for/cooking-apps): Cooking activation use case.
- [Edtech apps](https://sendlyr.com/for/edtech-apps): Edtech activation use case.

## Public evidence boundary

Typesy VIP treatment reached a 69.4% first-course-within-four-days hit rate across 121 users.
Control reached 57.9% across 57 users. Relative lift was 19.9%; absolute lift was 11.5 points.
This is an observed leading-indicator result. The public summary does not establish statistical significance or long-term retention lift.
